title: My Home and My Cat
text:
My house is small and blue. It has two windows and a red door. There is a big tree in the garden. The tree has green leaves.

My cat is black and white. Her name is Luna. She likes to sleep on the sofa. She is very friendly.

questions.text: What is the name of the cat?
How does the writer probably feel about the cat?
options: The writer is afraid of the cat
The writer does not know the cat
The writer is angry with the cat

questions.text: What kind of place is the garden most likely to be?
options: A place with a swimming pool

vocabulary.definition: a piece of land near a house where plants and trees grow
an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light
kind and pleasant to be with

paragraph_translations: Mi casa es pequeña y azul. Tiene dos ventanas y una puerta roja. Hay un árbol grande en el jardín. El árbol tiene hojas verdes.
Mi gato es negro y blanco. Se llama Luna. Le gusta dormir en el sofá. Es muy amigable.
